title: L¹_loc convergence of sets implies convergence of integrals of compactly supported continuous functions
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let A : ℝ → P(ℝ^N) be a family of subsets of ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) such that A(r) is Lebesgue null-measurable for all r in some set belonging to the filter 𝓝[>]0 (r ↓ 0). Let H ⊆ ℝ^N be Lebesgue null-measurable and g : ℝ^N → ℝ continuous with compact support. If L^N(tsupport g ∩ (A(r) Δ H)) → 0 as r ↓ 0, then ∫_{A(r)} g dL^N → ∫_H g dL^N as r ↓ 0. Here L^N = volume and set integrals are taken against the restricted measures.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A : ℝ → Set (Rn N)) (H : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ), (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet (A r) volume) → NullMeasurableSet H volume → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (tsupport g ∩ symmDiff (A r) H)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ∫ y in A r, g y) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y in H, g y))
